name: Carl Zeiss-Ikon Sonnar 57 mm f/ 2.0
note: No 56mm or 57mm Sonnar exists in any Contax RF line list; Carl Zeiss-Ikon is not a lens marking. A scrape-mangled listing of the 5cm f/2 Sonnar (56/57 is a misread of 5cm). Data already agrees: mount Contax RF, f/2.

name: Carl Zeiss Sonnar 135 mm f/ 4
note: Settled as the postwar Oberkochen RF lens (marked Zeiss-Opton then Carl Zeiss). The prewar Jena RF 13.5cm f/4 is the new curated record; the postwar CZJ SLR 135/4 (M42/Exakta) is the P3-renamed Jena row.

name: Carl Zeiss Tessar 50 mm f/ 3.5
note: Kept as the postwar West rigid Tessar 50/3.5, attested marked both Zeiss-Opton and Carl Zeiss. The prewar Jena collapsible is the new curated 5cm record.

name: Carl Zeiss Jena Triotar 85 mm f/ 4
note: Prewar (1932) and postwar-alloy Jena Triotar 85/4 are Contax RF only; no M42, Exakta or LTM version is attested. The recomputed postwar West lens is the new Zeiss-Opton Triotar 85/4 record.

name: Carl Zeiss Jena Sonnar 50mm f/2
aliases: Carl Zeiss Jena Sonnar 5cm f/2 T
note: Post-fold pin (loser-fields-win guard) after folding the phantom 57mm row; cm-form aliases added. Wartime/postwar Jena LTM 5cm f/2 Sonnars keep the M39/LTM mount legitimate.

name: Carl Zeiss Jena Sonnar 50 mm f/ 1.5
aliases: Carl Zeiss Jena Sonnar 5cm f/1.5 T
note: cm-form aliases for the prewar/wartime marking.

name: Zeiss Opton Sonnar 50mm f/ 1.5
note: Hyphenated and late Carl Zeiss marking spellings; the same Oberkochen optic was marked Zeiss-Opton until ~1953, Carl Zeiss after.

name: Carl Zeiss Jena Sonnar T 85 mm f/ 2
note: cm-form aliases; covers prewar uncoated and wartime/postwar coated Jena versions. The recomputed Oberkochen lens is the new Zeiss-Opton Sonnar 85/2 record.

name: Carl Zeiss Jena Biogon 35 mm f/ 2.8
aliases: Carl Zeiss Jena Biogon 3.5cm f/2.8 T
note: Prewar computation with the deep rear element (does not mount on IIa/IIIa); postwar East T-coated version is the same optic. The 1951 West recomputation is the separate Zeiss-Opton record.

name: Carl Zeiss Jena Olympia Sonnar T 180 mm f/ 2.8
note: cm-form aliases. Distinct from the 1966 Oberkochen Contarex Olympia-Sonnar 180/2.8 (separate mint).
